explanation: A Pharisee who persecuted Christians before he was converted on the road to Damascus, later known as the apostle Paul.
The city where Saul traveled to arrest the disciples and where his encounter with Jesus took place.
A bright light from heaven that blinded Saul during his conversion experience.
A Christian in Damascus who received a vision to lay hands on Saul so that he could see again and be filled with the Holy Spirit.
The apostle's friend who welcomed the new believer Saul and introduced him to the apostles in Jerusalem.
An experience where a person sees something supernatural or receives a message from God, as Ananias did regarding Saul.
The state in which a Christian is empowered by God's Spirit for witness and service.
